message.content: The Communications Solutions Group reported revenue of $1,345 million in the third quarter ended July 31, 2026, with growth driven by commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government markets [D1]. The Electronic Industrial Solutions Group reported revenue of $501 million in the same period, reflecting expansion across semiconductor, general electronics, automotive, and energy markets [D1]. Total segment operating income increased to $613 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, compared with $338 million a year earlier [D1].
